data.narrative:
Toka is a Series B-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $38M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies: 8 private firms at the same stage and 2 public market proxies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The private peer set includes Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B), establishing a range of $300M to $3.0B within the sector.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, using the $38M raised as a value proxy and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yields $72M. Peer-median analysis across the 8 same-sector, same-stage companies produces a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in Defense & Security business models and market positioning at this stage.

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $61M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $599M. The substantial gap between stage-progression ($72M) and peer-median ($1.1B) suggests material uncertainty around comparability and capital intensity within the sector. Key variables requiring clarification include revenue, growth trajectory, and competitive positioning relative to the higher-valued peer set, particularly Dream Security and Allen Control Systems.
